第95章 借势预热，网友助力-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

清晨。

上海几家本地生活类公众号同时推送了一篇文章。

标题很抓人：《老洋房的叹息：资本圈私人会所侵占公共风貌资源》。

文章没点名，没提林川，也没提藏锋。

但配图很讲究。

一张是衡复片区梧桐树下的铁门半掩，隐约露出里面修缮一新的青砖。

一张是几辆豪车停在路边的远景。

字里行间，全是指向性极强的词汇：

“圈层壁垒”、“历史建筑沦为少数人的饭局”、“噪音扰民”、“违规改造”。

发酵速度很快。

陆骁坐在新天地的酒店套房里，看着网站上不断上涨的阅读量和转发数，喝了一口冰水。

“这招管用。”

他抬头看向对面的朋友。

朋友凑过来看了一眼数据。

“陆少，这热度一起，街道那边肯定顶不住压力。就算他们材料齐，也得停工避风头。”

陆骁冷笑。

“林川不是要我负责到底吗？我看他这次怎么负责。上海的舆论，不是他有几个钱就能压住的。”

他拿起手机，给许泰发了条信息。

“火候差不多了。”

许泰没回。

陆骁不在意。

只要事情办成就行。

另一边，虹桥公寓。

沈蔓刚起床，正在整理搬家用的纸箱。

手机弹出了那篇文章。

她点进去看了几眼，眉头皱起。

虽然没点名，但她知道林川最近在弄茶楼。

她直接拨通了林川的电话。

“醒了？”

电话接通，林川的声音很平稳，背景音里有轻微的翻书声。

“你看到今天网上的文章了吗？”沈蔓问。

“看到了。”

“没影响吧？”

沈蔓停下手里的活。

“要不要我找几个媒体圈的朋友打听一下首发是谁？”

林川笑了笑。

“不用。你安心收拾你的新家，缺什么直接买，别给我省钱。”

“我跟你说正事呢。”

沈蔓有些急。

“正事就是，这把火烧不到我身上。”

林川语气轻松。

“晚上想吃什么？”

沈蔓听他这语气，心里的石头落了地。

“我自己做，你来吃。”

“好。”

上午九点。

震旦大楼。

林川的办公室里，气氛没有陆骁想象中的紧张。

苏晚棠拿着一份舆情报告站在桌前。

“林总，从早上七点到现在，三个边缘媒体号首发，随后有八个本地生活号跟进转发。评论区风向被引导得很明显，都在攻击‘老洋房变会所’。”

她顿了顿。

“要不要联系平台，先把热度压下来？或者发律师函限期删帖？”

林川看着窗外，没接那份报告。

“压热度？”

他转过转椅。

“为什么要压？”

苏晚棠一怔。

Early morning.

Several local lifestyle public accounts in Shanghai simultaneously pushed an article.

The title is very catchy: "The Lament of the Old Bungalow: Private Clubs in the Capital Circle Encroaching on Public Style Resources".

The article did not mention Lin Chuan or Zang Feng by name.

But the pictures are very particular.

One picture shows the iron gate under the plane tree in the Hengfu area half-opened, vaguely revealing the renovated green bricks inside.

One is a distant view of several luxury cars parked on the roadside.

Between the lines, there are words that are very directional:

"Circle barriers", "historic buildings reduced to a meal for a few", "noise disturbing residents", "illegal renovations".

Fermentation speed is very fast.

Lu Xiao was sitting in a hotel suite in Xintiandi, looking at the rising number of reads and reposts on the website, and took a sip of ice water.

"This works."

He looked up at his friend across from him.

A friend came over and took a look at the data.

"Master Lu, with this heat, the street side will definitely not be able to withstand the pressure. Even if they have all the materials, they have to stop work to avoid the limelight."

Lu Xiao sneered.

"Don't Lin Chuan want me to be responsible to the end? Let's see how he takes responsibility this time. Public opinion in Shanghai cannot be suppressed by him with just a few dollars."

He picked up his phone and sent Xu Tai a message.

"The heat is almost done."

Xu Tai didn't reply.

Lu Xiao didn't care.

As long as things get done.

On the other side, Hongqiao Apartment.

Shen Man had just gotten up and was sorting out the moving cartons.

The article popped up on my phone.

She clicked in and took a few glances, frowning.

Although she didn't name him, she knew that Lin Chuan was running a teahouse recently.

She dialed Lin Chuan's number directly.

"Are you awake?"

When the call was connected, Lin Chuan's voice was very steady, and there was a slight sound of turning books in the background.

"Did you see the article on the Internet today?" Shen Man asked.

"I saw it."

"It doesn't matter, right?"

Shen Man stopped what he was doing.

"How about I ask a few friends in the media circle to find out who the starter is?"

Lin Chuan smiled.

"No. You can pack up your new home with peace of mind. If you need anything, just buy it. Don't save money for me."

"I'm telling you something serious."

Shen Man was a little anxious.

"The main thing is, this fire can't burn me."

Lin Chuan's tone was relaxed.

"What do you want to eat tonight?"

When Shen Man heard his tone, his heart dropped.

"I'll make it myself, and you'll eat it."

"Okay."

Nine o'clock in the morning.

Aurora Building.

The atmosphere in Lin Chuan's office was not as tense as Lu Xiao had imagined.

Su Wantang stood in front of the table holding a public opinion report.

"Mr. Lin, from 7 o'clock in the morning to now, three fringe media accounts have been the first to post, and then eight local life accounts have followed up and forwarded it. The direction of the comment area has been clearly directed, and they are all attacking the old bungalow turned into a club."

She paused.

"Should I contact the platform to calm down the heat first? Or send a lawyer's letter to delete the post within a time limit?"

Lin Chuan looked out the window and did not accept the report.

"Pressure heat?"

He turned his swivel chair.

"Why press?"

Su Wantang was startled.
